versions.changelog: Sync 2.x rotation defaults: LCC streamed no -r, PLY SOG/streamed -90,0,0, PLY voxel -90,0,180, LCC voxel 0,0,180; add GPU-first guidance.
Rename skill and repository to splat-transform-workflow-for-lcc for clearer LCC conversion positioning.

supersplat-workflow 0.2.1

- Added detailed SKILL.md documenting the workflow for converting LCC/PLY Gaussian splat scenes to SuperSplat assets, including streamed LOD, SOG, voxel data, and viewer settings.
- Clarifies the differences between PLY and LCC as source formats, and sets default strategies for precision, alignment, and progressive delivery.
- Includes a multilingual policy for answering user queries in both Chinese and English, while preserving all technical terms and format names.
- Provides comprehensive guidance on coordinate transforms, preferred conversion commands, and value of each output type.
- Documents end-to-end deployment scripts, standalone asset conversion, and settings merging procedures for SuperSplat integration.
